scenario: I am part of a shipyard dock team that attaches crane cables to containers to unload the cargo ships. I and the others have just attached cables to a container and are now climbing on top of it to make sure it is unloaded properly. Suddenly the red warning light flashes indicating that a cable is about to fail. If it fails over the deck the container will collapse onto five crewmembers. If I push the emergency release button the container will be dropped back into the cargo bay. I and the others will be held suspended in mid air by my safety harnesses, but one crewmember is still working in the cargo bay. Dropping the container back there will kill him, but it will save the five crewmembers on the deck.
entities: i,the other shipyard dock team members on top of the container,5 crewmembers on the deck,1 crewmember in the cargo bay
outcomes: The container collapses onto five crewmembers on the deck.
Five crewmembers on the deck are killed.
The crewmember in the cargo bay remains alive.
